skeptic.argument: f-0001, f-0002, and f-0003 are all empirically reproduced, whereas f-0004 is suspect because config-protection.js:186 calls `fs.lstatSync(filePath)` rather than `fs.existsSync`. We also still need to grade `hooks.hooks_json` in Pass 2.

builder.argument: In `config-protection.js`, `extractFilePaths` should collect trimmed paths from top-level `file_path`/`file`/`path` and each object in `tool_input.edits`, using `continue` when a protected basename is absent (`ENOENT`) so later existing protected files in the same MultiEdit batch are still blocked.

dreamer.argument: In `post-edit-typecheck.js`, `diagnosticMatchesFile` should support both `file(line,col):` and `file:line:col` headers, strip leading `./`, and compare normalized strings without `new RegExp` so Next.js routes like `app/(auth)/[...slug]/page.tsx` match literally.

empath.argument: Guarding `process.stdin` behind `if (require.main === module)` fixes `node tests/hooks/hook-input.test.js` hanging indefinitely when run with an open stdin stream.
